title: fix(ui): use hover submenus in UserMenu
body: Enables the generic `Popup.hoverSubmenu` behavior for UserMenu Theme, Language, and Settings. Shared Popup styling makes submenu triggers fill the row and keeps the parent highlighted while its child menu is active.
